meta.verification: Each Agave Harmonic day checked against that day's own client roll-up at reports.firedancer.io: avg_fee 30/30 within 0.1% (median ratio 1.00000), avg_tip at 6% 30/30 within 0.1%. Blocks run 0.1-1.0% light -- Dune omits a few blocks a day, which does not move per-block means.
meta.basis: reward = fee + jito_gross*0.94. The 6% is Jito's own commission, measured not assumed: gross/report was 1.0638 for all 73 validators on 2026-09-07, stdev 1e-7. Gross of VALIDATOR MEV commission -- what the block earned, not what the operator banks.
meta.like_note: GBX also receives Titan/Bifrost tips (5.2% of its revenue, up to 17.3% on 2026-09-09) on routes Agave Harmonic never touches -- it had zero such inflow across 62,151 slots on 2026-09-07. Every comparison here uses fee + net Jito on BOTH sides and excludes those.
caveats: No post-connection filter on GBX: on 2026-08-11 only 4 of 11 validators had connected, and the cohort reaches 11 by 2026-09-02.
Cohort sizes differ ~5x (11 vs 50-61 validators), so operator quality, stake and datacenter mix are uncontrolled.
Percentiles cannot be pooled across days -- each day's curve is its own sample. There is deliberately no all-window ECDF.
p96-p100 rest on single-digit slot counts per day and swing hard; p5-p95 is the usable band.
